learning_outcomes.text: Understanding thermal behaviour of the electronic device and systems, and also, fundamentals of the thermal design in general.
Investigation of the effects of the design parameters on thermal systems.
Being able to conduct basic analyses related to computer aided thermal system design.
Investigation of the alternative recent electronic cooling methods and understanding the fundamental working principles.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to thermal design in electronic devices and fundamental principles of thermal design
Thermal conduction in electronic systems. Steady state and transient thermal conduction in electronic devices.
Thermal conduction in extended surfaces and heat sink design.
Thermal conduction in extended surfaces and heat sink design.
Thermal convection and radiation in electronic devices.
Principles of natural convection and free convection in parallel plates.
Computer aided electronic systems thermal design.
Phase change heat transfer in electronic systems
Heat transfer and fluid flow in microchannels.
Heat transfer and fluid flow in microchannels
Presentation of the project and research topics.
